documents_expected.why: 2027 guidelines: region, organisation requirements, categories, application period
application and report documents, with deadlines

eligibility.rule: Activities in developing countries, mainly Asia-Pacific, or in Japan
eligibility.quote: Region: Activities that are based in developing countries mainly in the Asia-Pacific region or inside Japan.

eligibility.rule: Incorporated, or a voluntary organisation of equivalent credibility
eligibility.quote: It has incorporated status or is a voluntary organization with societal credibility equivalent to an incorporated organization.

eligibility.rule: Three years or more of nature conservation projects (not for Basic A and B grants)
eligibility.quote: It has a record of conducting nature conservation projects for 3 years or more

eligibility.rule: Able to report on activities, budgets and finances
eligibility.quote: It can appropriately report its activities, budgets and financial status of granted projects, when requested by KNCF.
Grant for small-scale projects of 1 million Yen or less for the first-time applicant to the KNCF Grant Program.

eligibility.rule: Basic B: grassroots organisations in Least Developed Countries
eligibility.quote: Grant for small-scale projects of 1 million Yen or less for local grass roots organizations conducting activities in countries designated by the UN as Least Developed Countries.

eligibility.rule: Cooperation from local government, organisations and residents; experts involved
eligibility.quote: Appropriate cooperation has been obtained from the government organizations, related international organizations, non-governmental organizations and residents in the locations of the target projects.
alt_quotes: The project is implemented by experts with scientific knowledge, or the advice and cooperation of experts with scientific knowledge has been obtained in implementing the project.

eligibility.rule: Outsourcing no more than 10% of the grant
eligibility.quote: no more than 10% of the total grant amount may be applied to the outsourcing costs.

documents.item: Financial statements or audits for the past three years (not for Basic grants)
documents.quote: Financial statements or certified audits for the past 3 years.

documents.item: Proof of incorporation, for incorporated organisations
documents.quote: For incorporated organizations, documents that show proof of such incorporation

effort.step: Register a user account in the KNCF Management System (from 1 October 2026)
effort.quote: User registration is available from October 1st, 2026(Thu), 09:00, JST.

effort.step: Enter and upload the application in the System
If approved, revise the plan and budget to the approved amount
effort.quote: Submit the revised plan and budget by May 31st, 2027, 17:00, JST, using the System.

after_award.quote: Below, the necessary documents and procedures for the Interim Report (April - September).
alt_quotes: Below, the necessary documents and procedures for the Final Report (April - March). Deadline : April 30, 2028, 17:00 JST

notes: Four categories: Basic A (first-time, up to ¥1M), Basic B (LDC grassroots, up to ¥1M), Standard (up to ¥10M) and Collaboration (up to ¥20M a year for three years, two or more NGOs required). Only the Collaboration grant needs partners; the other categories say nothing either way, so consortium_required is left empty. Grant year April 2027 to March 2028. Permanent staff costs are not covered. Collaboration grants report in person in March instead of an interim report.
